description: Project-local research workflow memory, Prompt Architect Head Agent, one-shot goal autopilot, prompt normalization, adaptive storage policies, content ingest, standardized data packages, source lookup, OPHIS-style mechanistic ledgers, harness registry, hypothesis portfolio, monitored experiment-runner-plus reports, scratch-only code builder, math abstraction chain, Zotero/wiki exports, claim-evidence verification, deep-loop gate review routing, isolated problem-loop expert diagnosis, fail-open external supervisor review, unattended test loops, checkpoints, handoffs, lifecycle logs, portable skill/plugin packaging, plugin install channels, and skill routing for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Route resumable research projects with adaptive storage, ingest, evidence checks, mechanism ledgers, deep-loop gates, portable skills, and test feedback loops.
interface.longDescription: Codex Research Loop adds project-local research state, project profiles, a Prompt Architect Head Agent that rewrites rough natural-language requests into chain-forcing execution contracts for deep analysis, mathematical modeling, divergent reasoning, adversarial review, P10 problem escalation, and unattended continuation, one-shot goal autopilot for rough natural-language objectives, prompt normalization for incomplete requests, adaptive project-facing storage policies, canonical or existing-repo-compatible research layouts, explicit URL/local-file content ingest, article-processing packages, standardized data packages with raw bytes, metadata, schema, README, source metadata lookup through public scholarly APIs, OPHIS-style mechanistic ledgers for observations, phenomena, hypotheses, interventions, effect gates, mechanism candidates, and negative results, reusable harness registries for validation surfaces and promotion thresholds, divergent hypothesis portfolios with ranked falsifiable alternatives, monitored experiment-runner-plus plans and executions with environment fingerprints, retries, logs, artifact readback, and harness-compatible summaries, scratch-only evolutionary code-builder plans bound to harness evidence, math abstraction chains for definitions, assumptions, subgoals, lemma graphs, and verifier plans, Zotero-compatible collection plans, BibTeX and CSL-JSON exports, PDF attachment plans, llm-wiki-compatible pages, deterministic claim-evidence verification over evidence ids, sources, locators, and statuses, deep-loop gate evaluation that routes every pass through review_for_transition and every failed gate through review_for_retry, mechanism-memory gate arbitration that retries pending OPHIS effect gates, reuses supported mechanisms in continuation prompts, reads advanced research records into gate vectors, Research Council, Adversarial Gate, and continuation prompts, isolated problem-loop diagnosis with repo/context analysis, generated expert panels, captured test logs, adjustment plans, and gated promotion before core edits, fail-open external supervisor review for watchdog decisions, unattended validation/test/repair loops, updateable research records, checkpoints, handoff files, command run logs, lifecycle hook scripts, portable Codex skill/plugin packaging with prompt-submit routing, dispatch tables, local marketplace entries, managed plugin install channels, runtime plugin config enablement, MCP tools, multi-path task graphs, capability matrices, missing-tool gap reporting, and routing to academic, Nature-style, document, figure, and presentation skills.
